readable by DOM-text extraction tools.

declarations.name: GcdsContainer
declarations.description: A container is a basic box layout with a set width for its contents.

attributes.name: alignment
attributes.description:
Defines the container's alignment.
This property is ignored when `layout` is set to `page`,
as the page layout has higher priority.

attributes.name: border
attributes.description: Defines if the container has a border.

attributes.name: layout
attributes.description:
Controls how the container aligns with the page layout.
When set to `page`, the container uses a max width of 1140px and
switches to 90% width on smaller screens to scale consistently with
core page layout components such as the header and footer.
When set to `full`, the container spans the full width (100%)
of its parent.

attributes.name: margin
attributes.description:
Container margin. Horizontal margins (left and right) are not
applied if the container’s alignment property is defined, since
alignment has higher priority.

attributes.name: padding
attributes.description: Defines the container's padding.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Defines container size.

attributes.name: tag
attributes.description: Set tag for container.

declarations.name: GcdsGrid
declarations.description: A grid is a responsive, flexible column layout to position elements on a page.

attributes.name: align-content
attributes.description:
If total grid size is less than the size of its grid container,
this property aligns the grid along the block (column) axis

attributes.name: align-items
attributes.description: Aligns grid items along the block (column) axis

attributes.name: alignment
attributes.description:
Defines the grid's alignment if the grid containers
size is smaller than the parent's size.

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description:
Defines the default number of grid columns for all viewports if columns-tablet
and columns-desktop are not defined. Option to set different layouts for
desktop with columns-desktop and for tablet with columns-tablet.

attributes.name: columns-desktop
attributes.description: Provides option to set a different number of grid columns for desktop screens.

attributes.name: columns-tablet
attributes.description:
Provides option to set a different number of grid columns for tablet screens.
If columns-desktop is not defined, columns-tablet will be used to define the
number of columns for desktop as well.

attributes.name: container
attributes.description: Defines grid container size

attributes.name: display
attributes.description: Defines element as grid or inline-grid container

attributes.name: equal-row-height
attributes.description:
Sets all grid items to have an equal height,
based on the tallest item.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description:
Defines the horizontal and vertical spacing between items in
a grid container for all viewports if gap-tablet and gap-desktop
are not defined. Option to set different spacing for desktop
with gap-desktop and for tablet with gap-tablet.

attributes.name: gap-desktop
attributes.description:
Provides option to set horizontal and vertical spacing between items
in a grid container for desktop screens.

attributes.name: gap-tablet
attributes.description:
Provides option to set horizontal and vertical spacing between items in a
grid container for tablet screens. If gap-desktop is not defined, gap-tablet
will be used to define the spacing for desktop screens as well.

attributes.name: justify-content
attributes.description:
If total grid size is less than the size of its grid container,
this property aligns the grid along the inline (row) axis

attributes.name: justify-items
attributes.description: Aligns grid items along the inline (row) axis

attributes.name: place-content
attributes.description: Sets both the align-content + justify-content properties

attributes.name: place-items
attributes.description: Sets both the align-items + justify-items properties

attributes.name: tag
attributes.description: Set tag for grid container
